## Reports Agent gateway

How our own posts actually did (`performance`). Reads Zernio behind ZERNIO_API_KEY, including posts made directly on a platform and the LinkedIn page's own totals, so it cannot run in the browser.

Vercel Hobby allows 12 Serverless Functions per deployment. The repo hit that ceiling, so this runs beside n8n instead — see n8n/README.md.

Unlike the other two gateways this forwards a **GET with a query string**, because that is the handler's contract and moving it should not change it.

Webhook path: `/arak-agent-reports`. Allowed body actions: `performance`.
